build_chess_llm_agent: build a ChessLLMAgent that uses an LLM model to play chess moves from game observations
call_chess_llm_agent: call the ChessLLMAgent with a game state observation to get an LLM-generated chess move
build_chess_rethink_agent: build a ChessRethinkAgent with a sampler and prompt template for chess move generation with rethink strategy
build_default_rethink_agent: build a default ChessRethinkAgent with rethink strategy and optional image support for a given model
get_prompt_substitutions: get prompt substitutions for the current chess game state including move history and player name
